section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section presents a single study examining family fat talk's influence on mindful eating and positive body image in college women. The study extends prior research by using a comprehensive measure of family fat talk and applying a sociocultural model informed by positive psychology to examine both risk and protective factors. The proposed model tests whether body appreciation and functional body appreciation mediate the relationship between exposure to family fat talk and mindful eating.
